name: Compact Camping Cookset with Carrying Case
description: The cookset includes a 2‑liter pot, a 1‑liter pan, a folding kettle, and a set of nesting utensils, all made from lightweight aluminum. A silicone‑coated carrying case keeps everything organized and protects against scratches. Perfect for backpackers seeking a full kitchen in a small package.
shortDescription: Lightweight aluminum cookset for backpacking and campsite meals.
